name: Guinea

fees.name: Tourist e-Visa (single entry, <90 days)
fees.notes: Issued via official PAF (Police de l'Air et des Frontieres) portal paf.gov.gn. Non-refundable even if refused. Yellow fever certificate required. Processing about 3 business days.

fees.name: Business travel via e-Visa
fees.notes: Guinea's e-visa on the official PAF portal covers tourism, business and transit purposes at the same short-stay rate. A separate long-stay visa (VLS, 1 year) costs USD 150 but is a long-term category.

fees.name: Long Term Visa (Visa de Long Séjour / VLS)
fees.notes: Long-stay category (employment, business, family reunion, study) applied via the official PAF e-visa portal; USD 150, valid 1 year.

fees.name: Transit visa (max 3 days)
fees.notes: Applied for on the official PAF e-visa portal.

fees.name: Embassy-issued sticker visa
fees.notes: Guinean consulates (e.g. Consulate of Guinea) now redirect applicants to the official e-visa portal paf.gov.gn; no separate embassy sticker-visa fee schedule is published. Amount unverified, so left null.

fees.name: Visa on arrival
fees.notes: Entry at Conakry airport is possible with the e-visa pre-approval issued online; no separately published official on-arrival cash fee schedule was found, so amount is left null.

free_visa_notes: Visa-free entry applies only to ECOWAS member-state nationals and a few others; most travellers must obtain the paid e-visa.
